text:
alex: Heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/61234 touches routing + canary flag + auth header order. Need runtime, platform, infra, and security eyeballs before Tue merge window. Small change but affects fallback routing. @rohan @lee @security-sig @maya PTAL :eyes:

maya: saw it, can review runtime behavior tomorrow morning. any perf numbers? also what rollback looks like?

rohan: I can take platform + canary rollout config. If runtime blesses, I'll own canary steward. Need to know expected traffic increase.

alex: thanks. perf: local bench showed 2-3% tail latency improvement. No traffic spike expected; just routing fallback ordering. Rollback is revert + immediate canary cutoff (scripts in ops/tools/deploy_runbook.sh).

lee: infra: needs a quick check for header order in authz proxy. @infra-bot can you run the config lint?

infra-bot: config-lint OK for changed files (no schema breaks).

security-sig: quick glance — header reordering ok from authz standpoint, but add a unit-test for header canonicalization. cc @alex :mag:

alex: will add test. pushing a tiny commit now.

alex: snippet of test I'm adding:
```python
def test_header_order():
    req = make_req(['x-foo','authorization'])
    resp = route(req)
    assert 'authorization' in resp.headers
```

maya: lgtm after test. will approve when commit added. :+1:

rohan: I'll take canary steward role. ping me when CI green. prefer 10% initial canary.

alex: thanks all. target merge Tue 09:00 PT. marking owners: @rohan (canary), @maya (runtime signoff), @lee (infra), @security-sig (sec signoff). :thumbsup:
